categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Gaona Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of high-end metal materials including high-temperature alloys, aluminum-magnesium-titanium light alloys, corrosion-resistant alloys, and intermetallic compounds. Its products serve aerospace, aviation, shipbuilding, nuclear power, gas turbines, petrochemical, and metallurgical industries. The company operates through casting alloy products, deformed alloy products, and new alloy products segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as precision casting, forging and ring rolling, powder metallurgy, fine manufacturing, additive manufacturing (3D printing), and precision machining of disk and ring parts. It has capabilities in producing nickel-based high-temperature alloys, powder high-temperature alloys, oxide dispersion strengthened alloys, and metal intermetallic compounds, supported by key laboratories and engineering centers focused on innovation and process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the aerospace and aviation sectors, including domestic strategic suppliers to China Aviation Engine Group. Other major markets include gas turbine manufacturing, petrochemical, metallurgy, power generation, and glass industries. The company also serves international industrial furnace markets through its subsidiary Qingdao Xinlitong.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Beijing and production bases in multiple cities including Hebei, Qingdao, Sichuan (Deyang), Liaoning, Xi'an, and Zhuozhou. It has growing overseas sales, with exports accounting for over 15% of revenue, and is expanding direct sales internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Gaona operates mainly in the midstream segment of the metal materials supply chain, focusing on alloy material production and processing into components for high-end equipment manufacturing. It controls the full production chain from alloy melting to finished precision parts, including upstream alloy mother ingots and downstream precision machining.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in high-temperature alloys, powder metallurgy, additive manufacturing, and new alloy materials with a focus on aerospace engine components and gas turbines. It invests heavily in innovation platforms such as key laboratories and engineering centers, pursuing breakthroughs in material purity, 3D printing, and high-performance wear-resistant alloys. Strategic goals include expanding product lines, enhancing domestic and international market presence, and integrating digital and lean manufacturing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of alloy materials and precision alloy components based on customer orders. The company follows an order-driven production model, with some initial overseas sales via distributors transitioning to direct sales. Income also includes government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Gaona is one of the most comprehensive and technologically advanced producers of high-end and new high-temperature alloys in China, holding a leading domestic position with significant market share in deformed and powder high-temperature alloys. It is recognized as a strategic supplier to major aerospace engine manufacturers and has broken foreign monopolies in certain product categories. Competition is intensifying as more domestic players enter the high-temperature alloy market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 3.52 billion, a 3.4% increase over 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 248.7 million, down 22%. Total assets reached RMB 7.59 billion, growing 5.17%. The company maintains steady growth with increased R&D investment (8.31% of revenue) and expanding production capacity, though cash flow from operations declined significantly due to tighter industry liquidity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Gaona offers high-purity, high-performance alloy materials and precision components critical for advanced aerospace engines and other high-end equipment. Its competitive advantages include proprietary technologies, comprehensive production capabilities across multiple alloy types and manufacturing processes, strong R&D platforms, and close integration with key customers. The company emphasizes quality, customization, and innovation to meet stringent aerospace and industrial requirements, supporting domestic substitution of imported materials.
